description: An informal shelter payment record, such as a roommate payment record, money-order receipt, or arrears notice, showing an amount paid or overdue toward rent or shared housing costs.

payer_name.instruction: The full name of the person who made or owes the payment.

payee_or_provider_name.instruction: The name of the landlord, property provider, roommate, or service that received or is owed the payment, such as a money-order service.

document_type.instruction: Type of document, such as money-order receipt, roommate payment record, or overdue notice.

amount.instruction: The amount paid, if this document reflects a completed payment.

amount_overdue.instruction: The amount overdue or past due, if this document is a notice or arrears record.

service_period_start.instruction: Start of the service or rental period the payment or notice applies to. YYYY-MM-DD format.

service_period_end.instruction: End of the service or rental period the payment or notice applies to. YYYY-MM-DD format.

receipt_or_notice_date.instruction: The date the receipt was issued or the notice was sent. YYYY-MM-DD format.

reference_number.instruction: Any receipt, money-order, or notice reference number shown on the document.
